SCHOOL DISTRICT NO. 35 (LANGLEY)
STATEMENT OF FINANCIAL INFORMATION
STATEMENT OF SEVERANCE AGREEMENTS
FOR THE YEAR ENDED JUNE 30, 2025
There were two severance agreements made between School District No. 35 (Langley) and its
non-unionized employees during fiscal 2025.
The agreements represent 2 months’ compensation.
Prepared as required by Financial Information Regulation, Schedule 1, subsection 6(7)
